subject: Animation
title: Kubo and the Two Strings: Pushing Boundaries
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Kubo and the Two Strings: Pushing Boundaries.

hook.text: Laika built a sixteen-foot skeleton puppet for Kubo and the Two Strings — the largest ever in stop-motion.

buildup.text: The film blended Japanese mythology with breathtaking visual ambition that stunned audiences and critics.

discovery.text: Laika combined stop-motion, CGI, and practical effects so seamlessly that viewers could not tell which was which.

twist.text: Kubo earned just $77 million against a $60 million budget. Critical acclaim did not translate to profit.

climax.text: Kubo is considered Laika's artistic peak, even if the audience never fully showed up for it.

punchline.text: Stop-motion's most ambitious film deserved a bigger audience.

quiz.question: What technical achievement did Kubo and the Two Strings accomplish?
options: It was the first stop-motion film in color
It built the largest stop-motion puppet ever and seamlessly blended stop-motion with CGI
It was animated entirely by one person
